content:
- Finished the command-output-envelope reduction slice, committed it as 5bd4160a, and pushed it to origin/master.
- This slice removed the CommandOutputDto courier layer, moved CLI rendering onto direct owners, and updated the HA observer to parse NodeState and AcceptedResponse directly; all required validations passed: make check, make lint, make test, make test-long.
- Task 05-reduce-loop remains <passes>false</passes> because current tracked total is still 34126 lines (> 19k), but the slice is complete and Ralph task-switch bookkeeping has been updated.

- Started Choose-Task flow for this turn.
- Read prior progress, current active-task summary, done-task summary, and the list-active-tasks skill instructions.
- Refresh Ralph summaries, read choose-task rules, then select the highest-precedence unblocked task and write it to .ralph/current_task.txt.

- Refreshed Ralph task summaries and re-read the choose-task rules.
- Confirmed there are zero active failing bug tasks, no active meta-task, and exactly one unblocked failing task in current_tasks.md: .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/05-reduce-loop.md with <priority>high</priority>.
- Write that path to .ralph/current_task.txt and stop; the next worker should continue the reduce-loop story.

- Read previous Ralph progress and confirmed the active task path from .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Active task is .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/05-reduce-loop.md; next step is to inspect that task file and determine whether this turn is planning-only or execution.

- Read the reduce-loop task file and confirmed it still references plan 64-delete-command-output-envelope.
- Next step is reading that plan and the improve-code-boundaries skill to decide whether this turn should execute a new reduction slice or stop for replanning.

- Verified the old command-envelope plan is stale because CommandOutputDto no longer exists in src/tests.
- Current tracked size is 34,474 lines, so the task remains incomplete; next step is to map the largest remaining code areas and pick a fresh boundary reduction target.

- Mapped the remaining config_v2 test-helper corridor: private_schema still exports HA/operator/runtime renderers and string helpers, while external callers in HA support and binary tests either re-parse the rendered TOML or just need fixture text.
- Next step is verifying whether HA already has static fixture ownership that would let a new plan delete the HA-specific parser renderers instead of only moving them.

- Confirmed the previous plan 64 is stale because the command-output envelope slice is already complete in the current tree and the task still remains above the 19k target.
- Replanned the next reduction as .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/05-reduce-loop_plans/65-delete-public-config-test-renderers.md.
- The new plan targets the remaining public config_v2 test-renderer corridor: move HA-givens and observer fixture rendering to their owning test modules, localize CLI binary fixture rendering, remove public render/validation re-exports from config_v2, keep typed config constructors where still useful.
- Updated .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/05-reduce-loop.md to point at plan 65, reset execution/check boxes to pending, and marked the plan itself NOW EXECUTE.
- Stop now without implementation; the next worker should execute plan 65, run make check/lint/test/test-long, and only then continue the reduce-loop bookkeeping.

- Read prior Ralph progress and confirmed the active task is .ralph/tasks/story-config-v2-direct-cfg-collapse/05-reduce-loop.md.
- Starting this turn by reading the task file, current plan 65, and the improve-code-boundaries skill because the task is a code-reduction slice.
- Next step is to inspect whether plan 65 is still valid to execute as-is before making edits.

- Verified plan 65 is still valid: the public test renderer/export corridor is still only used by the HA givens harness, HA observer harness, CLI binary integration tests, and parser tests.
- Also checked git status so I can avoid trampling unrelated Ralph bookkeeping files already modified in the tree.
- Next step is to patch the concrete call sites and then remove the public re-exports once no external callers remain.

- Patched the concrete owners: HA givens now render their own runtime TOML, the observer harness renders its own operator TOML, and cli_binary owns a local runtime test-config renderer.
- Removed the public config_v2 re-export corridor for the deleted test renderers and the validation wrapper, and deleted the corresponding dead helpers from private_schema.
- Next step is to clean up any compile issues, format, verify the line diff stays negative, then run make check/lint/test/test-long.

- Fixed the obvious parser-test type mismatch, removed an unused leftover helper from private_schema, and ran cargo fmt successfully.
- Starting validation: first checking net line reduction, then running make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long as required by the task.
- If any gate fails, next step is to fix the code rather than relaxing or skipping the failing check.

- make test failed in two HA givens tests because the local HA runtime TOML omitted logging.postgres.cleanup.enabled.
- Patched the HA givens fixture template to include cleanup.enabled = true and am rerunning the affected tests with cargo nextest before restarting the full suite.
- If the focused rerun passes, next step is rerunning make test and then make test-long.

- Confirmed the HA shared secret files are stable test fixtures already committed in the repo, so the canonical-loader-compatible fix is to inline those values in the owned HA runtime TOML instead of pointing at host-missing /run/secrets paths.
- Patched the HA givens renderer accordingly and am rerunning the full make test gate rather than restoring the old public parse-only validator.
- If make test passes after this, the remaining required gate is make test-long.

- After inlining HA secret values, make test now fails because the canonical loader also resolves the HA fixture's absolute pg_hba.conf and pg_ident.conf paths.
- I am reading the committed shared HBA and ident fixture contents so the HA-owned runtime TOML can inline those as well and remain canonically loadable.
- Next step is to patch those access fields, rerun make test, and only proceed to make test-long once make test is clean.

- The HA givens fixture is now fully canonical-loader-friendly except for container-only Postgres binary paths, so I added a local host-validation adapter that rewrites those four paths to /bin/true before calling load_runtime_config_contents.
- This keeps the local boundary collapse without restoring the removed public parse-only validator.
- Next step is rerunning make test again; if that is clean, run make test-long.

- All required validations for this slice now pass: make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long.
- Current total remains above the story threshold at 34,484 lines, so the slice is complete but 05-reduce-loop must stay <passes>false</passes>.
- Next step is Ralph bookkeeping: update the task file for the completed slice, run task_switch.sh, commit everything, and push.
